title: Fast MAX-jump momentum regime on 2-hour candles, flat within the day

source.title: MAX momentum in cryptocurrency markets, via lab hypothesis H-024

rule_summary: Signals on CLOSED 2-hour candles built from completed 1h bars; fill at next 1h open. r(c)=C(c)/C(c-1)-1. MAX(c) = largest r of the last 30 candles. Jump regime ON when MAX(c) >= median of the 150 previous values of MAX (excluding the current). ENTRY at a 2h close when regime ON AND C > SMA(50) AND C > highest 2h close of the previous 10 candles AND no open position AND 3 candles since the last exit. EXIT when a 2h close < SMA(20). STOP: fixed 2% below entry (native). DAY-TRADE FRAME (same for every fast variant): entries only on bars opening 00:00-16:00 UTC, at most 2 entries per pair per UTC day; any open position is sold at the open of the 23:00 UTC bar or 12 hourly bars after entry, whichever comes first (never held overnight). Long only, spot, one position per pair, no pyramiding.
mechanism: After a large single-candle jump the lottery-like demand keeps pushing price for a while; the parent's windows are kept and the candle shrunk from 1 day to 2 hours so the continuation is traded within the day. Fast variant of a tried rule: the parent holds days or weeks; this one is forced flat within the day so the dry-run reaches 60 trades in weeks. Costs (0.30% round trip) are NOT relaxed.
